request: 6장 보조 작업 요청 v1 (문서 세션 -> 실험 세션, 2026-10-15). 학습 없음, 본 방법 고치지 않음, 3단계·비교 방법 발주 바꾸지 않음.
written: 2026-10-15 17:45 KST, before any result of this task

final_judgment_code.rule: auto = rules.default_rule: LoD2 current (marks at 1 tau), ALS margin_all_2 (marks at 2 tau)
final_judgment_code.training_code: fork r12 (stage 1) .. r15 (stage 3) read the same judgments (stage 0 fork check; r13-r15 judgment defaults = r12)

task5_judgment.range_note: R3 is inside R3E (R3 widened 10 m to the east), so R3 is counted through R3E, as in the discard-rule task
task5_judgment.range_inputs: training-only MVS of the discard-rule task (/dr/mvs/<range>), its meshes and stores (/dr/s02), own tolerance and registration (= the values the boxes fix), GT labels of /dr/s52/gt/<range> recomputed on the v6 store (--gt-from)
task5_judgment.box_inputs: stage-0 v6 runs (/s0/s61/box: the judgments the trainings read) and the stage-1 region files v3 (/s1/regions_v3: codes, labels with the common GT height alignment, premise flags)

areas.selection: range patches outside every box evaluation range, counted once in the order B0, R1, R2, R3E, R4, R5, SW (the data the fixed values and the rule were chosen on)
areas.evaluation: box patches inside the box evaluation range (the four experiment regions)

task5_judgment.patch_filter: in range (moved centre), not in an evaluation-exclusion cell, true label agree (0) or conflict (1)
task5_judgment.truth: label 0 = prior right (|GT - prior| <= tau), 1 = prior wrong; tau = the base tau of the patch kind
task5_judgment.judgment: release = patch judgment J_loc == conflict (a support patch's vote or a missing patch's propagated judgment); keep = agree, mixed, insufficient (inherit), and invisible patches (no judgment, the prior is kept)
task5_judgment.undetermined_note: mixed / insufficient are counted as keep and also shown separately

items.both_right: code 2: support, prior right, |MVS - GT| <= tau
items.prior_wrong: code 11: support, prior wrong, |MVS - GT| <= tau; split |GT - prior| / tau in [1, 4) and >= 4
items.image_wrong: code 3 within the conflict threshold (stage-1 gate condition 2 region): support, prior right, |MVS - GT| > tau, |MVS - prior| <= threshold (LoD2 1 tau, ALS 2 tau)
items.undecidable_passed: code 3 beyond the threshold (stage-1 premise violation): the wrong observation passed the confidence mask
items.undecidable_scene: B173_b0 whole evaluation range (most of the building faces changed); also with the box's own tolerance and registration
items.undecidable_region_offset: buildings confirmed as cases by task 4, if any: false conflicts = patches released whose |GT - prior - building offset| <= tau
items.both_wrong_record: code 12: prior wrong and |MVS - GT| > tau (recorded, not one of the seven items)
items.few_images: B0 image-count conditions of stage 3 (judge5 table, cond/<c>/box) cited, not recomputed

task5_judgment.box_code_source: boxes: code_ext_v3 and premise_violation of the region files v3 (MVS read at GT points for roof-like patches); ranges: the stage-0 rule on the patch medians (code 2/3 and 11/12 split by |-mvs_r_med - gt_med| <= tau, premise by |-mvs_r_med| > threshold)

confidence_excluded_supplement.purpose: 6.2 defines 'image wrong' as an observation the confidence mask excluded; the stage-1 regions hold only observations that passed the mask. This supplement finds the excluded wrong observations. Recorded, not a criterion.
confidence_excluded_supplement.rule: mask-off run (--conf photometric) with the mask-on tolerance and registration fixed; prior right (label 0) and |m_off - GT| > tau and (mask-on state missing or |m_on - GT| <= tau), m = MVS - prior of the patch median
confidence_excluded_supplement.runs: 7 ranges x 2 priors, boxes B0_b10, B173_b0, R1rep_b10 x 2 priors (B173nb_b10 mask-off exists in /s0/s61/box_maskoff)

task5_judgment.concentration: per building (footprint containing the patch centre; outside every footprint = 'no building'): wrong releases and wrong keeps by area; share of the five largest buildings; maps
task5_judgment.b173_self: s03 v6 on B173_b0 without --fix-from (own tolerance and registration on the box MVS), labels from the stage-1 v3 GT (--gt-from /s1/v3/box_gt/B173_b0), truth re-labelled with the fixed tau of the stage-0 box run so that only the judgment changes

task4_region_offset.data: the task-5 mask-on v6 range runs (scene-wide registration of each range applied): roof-like (kind 1) support patches in range, not excluded, finite MVS value
task4_region_offset.residual: r = MVS - prior per patch (vertical, = -mvs_r_med); patch medians, not pixels (pixel residuals are not stored per patch)
task4_region_offset.statistic: per building median m_b and NMAD s_b = 1.4826 median |r - m_b|
task4_region_offset.candidate: |m_b| > s_b (the vertical-bias rule of the method: median larger than NMAD)
task4_region_offset.dedupe: a building in several ranges is reported once, from the first range in the order of 'ranges'; the other values are kept in the CSV
task4_region_offset.gt_check: per building GT - prior over roof-like labelled patches: median g_b, NMAD sg_b, area with GT; MVS - GT median

classes.real_change: building in the real-change survey list (4959326, 4907510, 4907508, 4907207, R1 Z08 structure, C04, C27) or |g_b| > 2.0 m; checked on the photos
classes.prior_offset_case: not real change, GT confirms: |g_b| > sg_b with the sign of m_b
classes.image_side_offset: GT does not confirm (|g_b| <= sg_b): the offset is in the MVS
classes.no_gt: less than 10 m2 of labelled roof

task4_region_offset.effect_flag: |m_b| >= tau of the range and prior (the offset alone moves agreement to conflict)

horizontal_supplement.purpose: not to miss buildings offset only horizontally (walls cancel in a median). Recorded, not a criterion.
horizontal_supplement.rule: LoD2 only: wall-like support patches of the building, residual along the horizontal outward normal, robust 2D translation t_b (Huber, scale = NMAD); reported with the NMAD after the fit and the wall-normal direction spread

task3_figure.panels: (a) campus image with the eight search ranges and the four evaluation ranges + 10 m band, named; (b)-(e) one per region with the evaluation range and the item sites (new names), short labels, colour never alone
task3_figure.sites_source: item sites from the task-5 region codes and earlier reports (real-change survey, stage 1)
not_marked: R1 flat roofs measured 20-30 cm low (doc decision 10-15)
task3_figure.outputs: PNG for the text, source (script + data), list of marked sites (region, item, coordinate range)
